map.反应安全：水分与杂质影响反应与产物: Reaction safety: moisture and impurities affect reaction and products
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于投料验收: Report usability: all three must pass before the batch is accepted for charging
map.逐项判定：纯度≥99.5%、含水量≤0.2%、杂质含量≤0.1%；三项均满足为合: Item-by-item: purity ≥ 99.5%, moisture ≤ 0.2%, impurity content ≤ 0.1%; all three satisfied = pass. Purity and impurity relate to yield and by-products; moisture must be strictly controlled in some systems.
Purity 99.7% (≥99.5 ✓), moisture 0.1% (≤0.2 ✓), impurity 0.05% (≤0.1 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If purity drops to 99.0% it fails, raising side-reaction risk.
map.属工业优级常见要求；电子/医药级常要求 99.9% 以上，须按用途确定合格线，越: It is a common requirement for industrial premium grade; electronic/pharma grades often require ≥99.9%, and the pass line depends on use — lower impurity reduces side-reaction risk.
map.水分上限为什么这么低？: Why is the moisture upper limit so low?
map.对遇水反应、水解或影响催化活性的体系，0.2% 水分已足以改变反应甚至产气危险；: For water-reactive, hydrolyzable, or catalytically sensitive systems, 0.2% moisture is already enough to alter the reaction or even generate gas hazardously; control moisture per the material safety data sheet.
